description: Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) enables sellers and vendors to programmatically access their Amazon store data for listings, orders, payments, reports, and fulfillment.
auth_notes: Uses Login with Amazon (LWA) for OAuth2 access/refresh tokens combined with AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) for request signing.
credential_notes: Developers must register via the Solution Provider Portal, create a developer profile, and undergo account/app review and role approvals before production credential access is granted.
api_notes: Extensive public surface covering orders, catalog items, listings, pricing, fees, finances, reports, feeds, fulfillment (FBA/MCF), and data kiosk GraphQL queries.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Amazon; only community-driven explorations may exist.
rationale: While the API is fully documented and provides a sandbox, real production access requires rigorous developer registration, role qualifications, and admin approval.

evidence.note: Describes LWA OAuth2 tokens and AWS SigV4 request signing.
Details developer profile creation, solution provider portal registration, and approval steps.
Lists the comprehensive SP-API surface areas like Orders, Listings, Reports, and Data Kiosk.
